blurb: Guests can charter the Millie B for private cruises on Lake Winnipesaukee, covering Wolfeboro, Alton, Glendale, and Tuftonboro sides of the lake. Group tours offer a 45–60 minute docent-facilitated experience featuring classic wooden boats and stories of the lake's boating history. The museum also offers boat building programs where participants build their own boats over nine days.
